findings.finding: The July 15, 2026 BlackRock 8-K explicitly reports 50 Hudson Yards, New York, New York 10001 as the address of principal executive offices; BlackRock's current office directory lists the same New York office.
Current primary-source review still identifies Fink as chairman and CEO and does not establish a publicly named successor.

Post-July-25 current-news and BlackRock investor-relations searches found no material new CEO-succession announcement suitable for ingestion; Q2 earnings and annual-meeting material already existed in the selected dataset, so no filler news event was added.
